label: digit 1 input at position 0 or 1 of the original sequence
explanation: Fires only when the input token is the digit 1 during the original phase, almost entirely at step 0 or step 1 (about 49% and 50% of activation mass). Strongest at t=0 (about 1.0 of max); at t=1 it is weaker (about 0.72-0.81 of max). There is a small weak tail at t=2 (0.7% of mass) and no activation at t>=3. Never fires on other tokens, on the delimiter, or in the copy phase, including when 1 is input or output during copying. In dev the predicate has precision 1.0 and F1 0.97.

issues: The firing predicate holds up. On the test split it scores precision 1.0, recall 0.94, F1 0.969 and mass recall 0.993, with 0 false positives. Every activation is in the original phase with in_tok == '1'. There is no activation at t>=3, on the delimiter, or in the copy phase.

The magnitude claim is wrong. The explanation says the feature is strongest at t=0 (about 1.0 of max) and weaker at t=1, with t=1 making up the lowest quartile. Test quartile coverage says otherwise. t==0 covers quartiles [0.0, 0.76, 1.0, 0.12], so t=0 sits in the middle quartiles and covers only 12% of the top quartile. t==1 covers [0.76, 0.24, 0.0, 0.88], so t=1 holds 88% of the top quartile and also 76% of the bottom quartile.

Activation at t=1 splits into two groups that depend on prev_tok. The top dev examples are all '0 [1:1.00]' (1 after 0 at t=1). The bottom-quartile examples are 1 after letters such as v, n and s (0.72-0.79). On mass, t=1 (0.505) is slightly ahead of t=0 (0.488).

The t=2 tail is about 6% of active steps (2134 test misses) but only 0.7% of mass, all weak (0.04-0.20). The t=2 predicate has precision 0.13, so this tail is scattered noise, not a separate class worth adding.
The label itself ('digit 1 input at position 0 or 1') does not overclaim relative to the predicate. The problem is the false magnitude ordering in the explanation.
skeptic.revised_label: digit 1 input at original position 0 or 1. Activation is mid-range at t=0. At t=1 it depends on the previous token: highest after '0' and weaker after some letters. A weak tail appears at t=2.

final_label: digit 1 input at original position 0 or 1. Activation is mid-range at t=0. At t=1 it depends on the previous token: highest after '0' and weaker after some letters. A weak tail appears at t=2.
